name: PSG College of Technology (PSG Tech)
summary: PSG College of Technology in Coimbatore was established in 1951. It is a government-aided, autonomous college affiliated to Anna University; it has been autonomous since 1978–79 (first under the University of Madras, then Bharathiar University). It is NAAC-accredited and most of its programmes are NBA-accredited. Aided and self-supporting programmes charge different fees.
